item.name: 1. Service 4 — Threat Intelligence (Mohammad Nasrallah)
Mohammad Nasrallah — Add threat indicator — IP address indicator

request.description: Adds a critical malicious IP indicator. The value is validated as an IP address and stored canonically.

body.raw:
{
  "threat_type": "IP Address",
  "threat_value": "198.51.100.{{m_ip_octet}}",
  "description": "Command-and-control host observed in outbound beaconing",
  "severity": "Critical",
  "source": "Internal detection"
}

item.name: Mohammad Nasrallah — Add threat indicator — Domain indicator

request.description: Adds a high-severity suspicious domain. Domain format is validated and lowercased.

body.raw:
{
  "threat_type": "Domain",
  "threat_value": "run-{{m_run_id}}.malicious-update.test",
  "description": "Phishing domain impersonating the update portal",
  "severity": "High",
  "source": "Threat feed"
}

item.name: Mohammad Nasrallah — Add threat indicator — File hash indicator

request.description: Adds a medium-severity malware hash. The digest length identifies MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256 or SHA-512.

body.raw:
{
  "threat_type": "File Hash",
  "threat_value": "{{m_sample_hash}}",
  "description": "Dropper sample recovered from an email attachment",
  "severity": "Medium",
  "source": "Malware analysis"
}

request.description: The same threat type and value cannot be stored twice. A database uniqueness constraint rejects the duplicate, so concurrent requests cannot both succeed.

  "description": "Command-and-control host observed in outbound beaconing",

item.name: 2. Service 5 — Security Audit Logging (Mohammad Nasrallah)

request.description: Records a security activity. Integrating services call this endpoint with an administrator service token and the acting user in user_id.

body.raw:
{
  "user_id": "{{m_analyst_id}}",
  "action": "Threat indicator reviewed",
  "description": "Analyst reviewed a critical threat indicator during triage",
  "severity": "Information",
  "related_service": "Service 4: Threat Intelligence"
}

item.name: Mohammad Nasrallah — Create log record with an Idempotency-Key

request.description: Integration contract for Services 1–3 and 7–9: supplying an Idempotency-Key makes delivery retries safe. The first call creates the record.

body.raw:
{
  "user_id": "{{m_analyst_id}}",
  "action": "Incident assigned",
  "description": "Analyst reviewed a critical threat indicator during triage",
  "severity": "Information",
  "related_service": "Service 3: Incident Management"
}

item.name: Mohammad Nasrallah — Replay the same Idempotency-Key (no duplicate)

request.description: Replaying a key returns the original record with HTTP 200 instead of creating a second row, so a teammate retry cannot duplicate the event.

{
  "user_id": "{{m_analyst_id}}",
  "action": "Incident assigned",
  "description": "Analyst reviewed a critical threat indicator during triage",

item.name: 3. Service 6 — Security Reports (Mohammad Nasrallah)
Mohammad Nasrallah — Generate security summary report

request.description: Overall platform status: user, asset, open incident and critical threat totals. Compare these figures with the database records to verify them.
